coder_notes: Population: IDH-mutant astrocytoma and IDH-wildtype GBM cohort plus solid-tumour brain-metastases cohorts; coded basket_gbm_eligible (multi-cancer conditions list); mixed_glioma_gbm_named is the alternative, both include. NEO212 is the only investigational agent; record calls it a novel chemical entity (TMZ-perillyl alcohol conjugate), so not treated as an established temozolomide experiment, though adjudicator may wish to confirm. Regimen coded monotherapy for the GBM arm (NEO212 alone); brain-metastases arms combine NEO212 with SOC regimens that patients are already receiving (all SOC drugs coded soc_backbone). FOLFIRI lists 'Zaltrap' as other name and an aflibercept-like dose; listed aflibercept as soc_backbone with this caveat. PD-L1, EGFR/ALK and MSI-H/dMMR rows are label-indication requirements for brain-metastases SOC arms, not linked to the candidate. IDH row defines the glioma cohorts.
